messages:
Priya: Quick sync request 1: model admittance playbook draft for onboarding external customer models. Need: safety checklist, data residency flag, benchmark weightings, and an explicit deprecation cadence. Customer Y wants tighter SLAs.

Liam: Agreed. Proposed lightweight gating: safety (toxicity + PII scans), perf (p95/throughput), and fidelity (task-specific evals). Keep onboarding < 5 steps.

Carlos: For benchmark weighting, recommend: 50% task fidelity, 30% latency/cost, 20% robustness (adversarial QA). Keeps quality primary but still accounts for cost/ops.

Anya: Ops constraints: if model requires new quantization or kernel work, add a queue step and extend onboarding ETA by +2 weeks. Also surface if model needs external libs for Private customers.

Priya: Safety checklist idea (short):
- Run PII detector on training corpus sample
- Run toxicity classifier on >=1k outputs
- Check hallucination rate on retrieval tasks
- Confirm license/commercial terms
- Data residency flag set? (yes/no)
Would we require remediation before admitting?

Liam: If PII or license issues found, require remediation. For minor toxicity flags we can add mitigation via prompt/workflow guards and mark as "soft-gated".

Carlos: Add explicit metric names so engineers can hook them:
```
F1_SUMMARY >= 0.72
QA_EMBED_RERANK_NDCG >= 0.65
TOXICITY_RATE <= 0.01
P95_LATENCY <= 300ms
```
Link to eval suites: https://go/redwood/evals/onboard-core\n
Priya: Good. What about version pinning policy? Customer wants to pin major versions per contract. I propose default pin window = 45 days for Hosted, 90 days for Dedicated/Private but negotiable. Add a soft-notice 14 days before any non-backcompatible change.

Anya: We need an infra hook: ability to honor pin at routing layer and an automated fallback if canary fails. Ops-bot can we create a routing feature ticket?

ops-bot: Created ticket INF-3142: routing-pin-feature. Assigned to @Anya.

Liam: Deprecation cadence: recommend staged retire: notice (60 days Hosted / 120 days Dedicated), canary opt-in period (14d), forced cutover window (configurable), plus migration helpers (compat adapter shim if feasible).

Carlos: Also require a short migration runbook per model that includes: schema diffs, example prompts, and a small compatibility test harness. Customers get the runbook with the comms.

Priya: Draft comms template (2 short paragraphs + bulleted impacts). Will include timeline and who to contact (CS + Escalation).

Anya: Edge case: models with user data fine-tuning. If customer-trained checkpoints are present, require explicit data deletion and retention policy before migration. Add a checkbox in playbook.

Liam: Ok action list:
- Priya: write comms + runbook template (EOD Tue)
- Carlos: finalize metric names + weighting doc and example eval commands
- Anya: confirm infra constraints and timeline for routing pin ticket (INF-3142)
- Liam: assemble single-playbook doc and PR to /docs/model-admittance (will own)

Target: ship RFC + PR by next Wed.

Priya: I'll paste the comms snippet here when ready. Also tagging CS lead @Marta to prep customer outreach.

Carlos: Small Q: do we allow customer-requested longer pins as paid add-on? That seems reasonable and should be a sales/pm call.

Priya: Yes, will add note: "pin windows negotiable per contract (sales/PM approval required)".

Liam: Great. If nobody objects, I'll create the first PR skeleton and link it here.

Anya: :thumbsup: Looping in security for the PII checklist.

Priya: Thanks all. Adding any extra edge cases to INF-3142.
